from dotenv import find_dotenv, load_dotenv
from joltio import Client

# Looks for .env from the folder you run in; plain load_dotenv() fails outside a normal script.
load_dotenv(find_dotenv(usecwd=True))  # JOLTIO_API_KEY (and SSL_CERT_FILE, if set)
j = Client()

df = j.data.query("""
SELECT toDate(datetime) AS day, round(avg(price), 2) AS avg_price
FROM (
  SELECT datetime, argMax(price, inserted_at) AS price
  FROM omie.prices
  WHERE country = 'ES' AND program = 'PDBF' AND datetime >= today() - 7
  GROUP BY datetime
)
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day
""")
df

df = j.data.query("""
SELECT 'intraday' AS series, if(source = 'continuous', 'continuous', 'pdbf') AS label, datetime, value
FROM (
  SELECT 'continuous' AS source, datetime, round(argMax(price, inserted_at), 2) AS value
  FROM omie.continuous_prices
  WHERE country = 'ES' AND round = 0
    AND toDate(datetime) = (SELECT max(toDate(datetime)) FROM omie.continuous_prices WHERE country = 'ES' AND round = 0 AND datetime >= today() - 3)
  GROUP BY datetime
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'pdbf' AS source, datetime, round(argMax(price, inserted_at), 2) AS value
  FROM omie.prices
  WHERE country = 'ES' AND program = 'PDBF'
    AND toDate(datetime) = (SELECT max(toDate(datetime)) FROM omie.continuous_prices WHERE country = 'ES' AND round = 0 AND datetime >= today() - 3)
  GROUP BY datetime
)
""")
df

df = j.data.query("""
SELECT 'generation' AS series,
  multiIf(indicator_id = 4, 'nuclear', indicator_id IN (3, 10064), 'hydro', indicator_id IN (12, 13), 'wind', indicator_id = 14, 'solar_pv', indicator_id = 15, 'solar_thermal', indicator_id = 9, 'ccgt', indicator_id = 10086, 'cogeneration', 'other') AS label,
  datetime, round(sum(mwh) * 4, 0) AS value
FROM (
  SELECT indicator_id, datetime, argMax(value, inserted_at) AS mwh
  FROM esios.indicators
  WHERE indicator_id IN (3, 4, 9, 12, 13, 14, 15, 20, 21, 22, 23, 24, 10064, 10086) AND geo_id = 8741
    AND toDate(datetime) = (SELECT max(toDate(datetime)) FROM esios.indicators WHERE indicator_id = 4 AND geo_id = 8741 AND datetime >= today() - 1)
  GROUP BY indicator_id, datetime
)
GROUP BY label, datetime
""")
df

df = j.data.query("""
SELECT 'demand' AS series, if(indicator_id = 1293, 'real', 'forecast') AS label, toStartOfFifteenMinutes(datetime) AS datetime, round(avg(mw), 0) AS value
FROM (
  SELECT indicator_id, datetime, argMax(value, inserted_at) AS mw
  FROM esios.indicators
  WHERE indicator_id IN (1293, 544) AND geo_id = 8741 AND toDate(datetime) = today()
  GROUP BY indicator_id, datetime
)
GROUP BY indicator_id, datetime
""")
df
